body:
This works for me with GDM launching Hyprland via UWSM and sway (through whichever method our sway module uses by default).

These env vars appear to be propagated into the session on 25.11 too, so we're not changing anything in that regard.

Given that this is a major regression (I couldn't even switch to TTY..), this needs to be backported to 26.05 ASAP. cc @yayayayaka @jopejoe1

(I'd also very much like to know why tf. GDM needs to leak its shit into my session at all? All of this feels immensely stupid. Why can't it just take the env vars given to it and execv like a normal program? I need to look into getting rid of GDM..)
